data.body_html:
Choosing between the Fairline Targa 12m and the Pershing 46 for your Marbella boat charter? Both are sport cruisers that turn heads in Puerto Banús, but they offer different experiences. The Fairline is a British-built, classic flybridge-less design focused on comfortable cruising, while the Pershing is an Italian speed machine built for adrenaline. This guide compares their specs, performance, and charter value so you can pick the right one for your day on the Costa del Sol.

Fairline Targa 12m vs Pershing 46: Key Specs at a Glance

Both boats depart from Puerto Banús and carry up to 10 passengers. Here’s how they stack up:

FeatureFairline Targa 12mPershing 46
Length12 m14 m
Max passengers1010
Cruising speed28–32 knots35–40 knots
Top speed~38 knots~45 knots
Design originBritish (Fairline)Italian (Pershing)
Cabin / headYes (double berth + toilet)Yes (double berth + toilet)
Charter pricingOn request (WhatsApp)On request (WhatsApp)

Performance and Handling

The Pershing 46 is the faster boat. Its deep-V hull and powerful engines deliver a thrilling ride, hitting 40+ knots with ease. It’s built for speed, with precise handling that makes it a favourite for those who want to feel the wind. The Fairline Targa 12m is no slouch—it cruises comfortably at 30 knots—but it prioritises a smoother, more stable ride. If you’re prone to seasickness or prefer a relaxed cruise, the Fairline is better. For pure speed, choose the Pershing.

Design and Deck Layout

The Pershing 46 flaunts aggressive Italian styling: sharp lines, a low profile, and a large sunpad aft. The cockpit is sleek, with a wraparound windshield and sporty helm. The Fairline Targa 12m has a more traditional, timeless look with a spacious cockpit, L-shaped seating, and a fold-down transom that extends the deck. The Fairline’s deck is more social, with room to move around. The Pershing’s deck is more about sunbathing and speed.

Onboard Amenities and Comfort

Both boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. The Fairline’s cockpit has a wet bar and ample seating, while the Pershing’s interior is more luxurious, with leather upholstery and a modern galley. Below deck, the Pershing offers a slightly more spacious cabin with a double berth and separate head. The Fairline’s cabin is functional but cosy. For extended stays, the Pershing edges ahead in comfort.

Charter Pricing and Value

Neither boat has published hourly rates; pricing is on request via WhatsApp. However, based on our fleet structure, the Fairline Targa 12m is likely more affordable, falling into a mid-range tier similar to the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h). The Pershing 46 commands a premium for its speed and brand cachet. Both charters include all standard inclusions, so you pay for the experience, not extras. Contact us for a custom quote.

Which Boat Is Right for You?

Choose the Fairline Targa 12m if you want a classic, comfortable sport cruiser for a relaxed day with friends or family—ideal for anchoring at Cala del Faro or Cabopino. Choose the Pershing 46 if you crave speed, Italian design, and a head-turning presence. Both are excellent choices from our Marbella boat rental fleet. To discuss your preferences or book, send a WhatsApp message to our team.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which boat is faster, the Fairline Targa 12m or the Pershing 46?

The Pershing 46 is generally faster, with top speeds around 45 knots thanks to its deep-V hull and powerful engines. The Fairline Targa 12m cruises comfortably at 28–32 knots and tops out near 38 knots. For pure speed, choose the Pershing.

Can I charter both boats for a full day in Marbella?

Yes, both the Fairline Targa 12m and Pershing 46 are available for full-day charters from Puerto Banús. Pricing is on request via WhatsApp, and includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Contact us to check availability and tailor your itinerary.

How many guests can each boat accommodate?

Both boats carry a maximum of 10 passengers. This includes the skipper, so your party can have up to 9 guests. The deck layouts differ: the Fairline offers a spacious cockpit, while the Pershing has a larger sunpad area.

Which boat is better for a group of friends?

The Pershing 46 is ideal for groups who want a sporty, high-speed experience with a sleek Italian design. The Fairline Targa 12m offers a more relaxed, classic British feel with good social spaces. Both have a bimini top for shade.

Do the boats have cabins or bathrooms?

Both boats have a small cabin below deck with a double berth and an enclosed head (toilet). The Fairline Targa 12m has a compact but functional interior, while the Pershing 46 offers a slightly more modern, luxurious finish.

What is the best itinerary for these boats from Puerto Banús?

A popular route is heading east to Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés for swimming, or west to Cabopino and Estepona. Both boats can anchor in shallow coves. Your skipper will recommend the best spots based on sea conditions.

How do I book the Fairline Targa 12m or Pershing 46?

Send a WhatsApp message to our team with your preferred date, group size, and boat. We’ll confirm availability, provide a custom quote (including all inclusions), and arrange the charter. Expect a response within hours.

Are there any extra costs I should know about?

All our charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. There are no hidden fees. If you want a jet ski, lunch at a chiringuito, or extended hours, those are arranged separately and quoted upfront.
